title: SenML to IPSO Direct gateway translation
description:
Add bidirectional translation in gateway module

- SenML record with IPSO-style name (3303/0/5700) -> IPSO Direct path + value
- IPSO Direct response -> SenML record with object/instance/resource name
- Preserve units and timestamps where applicable
- Use for bridging heterogeneous networks

Reference: spec/07-transport-app.md section 10.2.2, appendix-senml.md
